subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should same-agent live transcript hits be authorized from `sessions/<agent>/<stem>.jsonl` path-owner metadata when the combined session store has no entry?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but it intentionally changes a session transcript visibility boundary from fail-closed to same-agent-visible for this orphan path.

options.title: Accept same-agent fallback
options.body: Merge this bounded fix because owner-scoped indexed paths are trusted same-agent metadata and cross-agent hits still fail closed.

options.title: Require store-backed redesign
options.body: Pause the PR and require live hits to resolve through persisted session identity instead of synthesizing a key from the path.

recommendation.title: Accept same-agent fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this bounded fix because owner-scoped indexed paths are trusted same-agent metadata and cross-agent hits still fail closed.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the merged memory/QMD session identity mapping work that defines the nearest maintainer boundary for this decision.
